key_insight: A transfer-learned, uncertainty-aware transformer model can screen greener solvent substitutes for emerging materials even when experimental solubility data are scarce.
engineering_relevance: This enables high-throughput, low-data solvent selection for organic photovoltaics and related materials workflows, reducing trial-and-error and supporting safer, more sustainable process design.
method: Pre-train on QM9 molecular targets, then transfer to solubility-descriptor prediction with minimal task-specific data.
Add uncertainty quantification so users can rank candidates by both predicted performance and confidence.
Deploy a customizable screening tool to identify and prioritize greener solvent alternatives.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports strong performance on established targets like Hansen solubility parameters and dielectric constant, and also on sparse-data targets such as Gutmann donor and acceptor numbers.
watch_item: Predictions should still be experimentally validated, especially for out-of-distribution solvents and tasks with very limited training data.
paper_title: A green solvent screening tool for emerging materials via uncertainty aware, transformer enhanced transfer learning
